## Activity

During July 2020, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 121 captures. This activity represents the photographic workload completed at the site during the reporting period. The capture total provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no further operational issues recorded in the report.

## Image quality

Of the 121 captures, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.0 per cent. This measure identifies the proportion of captures for which image quality was insufficient to support grading. The result is reported alongside the total capture activity to provide context for the site’s image quality performance during July 2020.

## Grading

Grading identified 25 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. This indicates the midpoint time between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. The grading figures should be considered together with the image quality result, as ungradable captures cannot contribute to a completed grading outcome. Overall, the report records site activity, image quality and grading performance for West Gate Eye Clinic in July 2020.
